```bash
# score: 20-flight and stitched 2x20, 10 attempts, lookahead (100 validation seeds)

TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_37_windowed_control/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --lookahead 4
```
